title: Agent Archivist doctor result (archivist.cli-result/v1)
description: The result document of the `doctor` command (plan Phase 5; CLI-019): one non-mutating health examination of the client — configuration resolution, filesystem permissions, SQLite integrity, lock ownership, source readability, spool free space, clock sanity, server readiness, and client-key linkage. The document is the healthy report only: a command that found anything needing operator action fails (ERR-029), emits its findings as `archivist.error/v1` diagnostics on stderr (ERR-030), and exits with the most severe finding's registered class, so every check verdict here is `ok` and can never be anything else within v1. Every field is a content-free counter, a mode literal, or a closed-vocabulary token; no field carries a path, an identifier, a transcript body, or a secret value or reference string (SEC-004, CFG-027). The examination never mutates: it opens state read-only, probes the lock without creating or retaining ownership, and touches the network only with one readiness connection.

x-archivist.compatibility: member additions are additive within v1 per plan Section 7.1 (CLI-015); redefining or removing a member, or a new namespace, is a v2 event

schema.description: The CLI result namespace. Present in every result document so a consumer always knows which contract it is reading before anything else (VAL-001); an unknown namespace is not this format and fails closed.

generated_at.description: The instant the examination ran (plan Section 7.3).

verdict.description: The overall verdict. Pinned to `ok`: a doctor run that found anything needing action is a failed command that emits no stdout document (ERR-029, CLI-019), so a document with any other verdict cannot exist within v1.

checks.description: One verdict per named check the plan's doctor deliverable pins.

evidence.description: The content-free evidence figures behind the check verdicts: modes, counters, and clock bounds. Reporting is by property, never by content (CFG-023).

configuration.description: Every configuration key resolved from its declared sources. A resolution failure fails the command before this document exists.

permissions.description: The state directory and present state files carry the pinned modes (directories 0700, files 0600; CFG-023).

sqlite_integrity.description: The read-only snapshot's automated integrity, foreign-key, and schema-object checks passed (CLI-009).

lock_ownership.description: The state directory lock is in a healthy state — free, or held by the one mutator the design allows (CLI-007). A held daemon lock is healthy, so this check never fails; the document records which state it found.

source_readability.description: Every adapter scan the composition supplied classified its source readable; no scan was forced to the failed coverage state.

spool_space.description: Free space on the state filesystem is at or above the configured floor (OPS-003).

clock_sanity.description: The local clock is within the accepted skew window of the freshest recorded event (plan Section 5: 5-minute allowance).

server_readiness.description: One readiness connection to the ingest endpoint succeeded.

client_linkage.description: Local state holds a server-issued receipt, the durable evidence this client was linked. No receipt is a diagnosis to link, not corruption.

check-verdicts.description: The named checks and their verdicts.

state_dir_mode.description: The state directory's permission bits as a four-digit octal literal (expected 0700; CFG-023). The mode, never the path.

spool_dir_mode.description: The spool directory's mode, or null when the directory does not exist yet — a fresh installation's expected state, not corruption.

state_db_mode.description: The state database file's mode (expected 0600; CFG-023).

lock_file_mode.description: The mutator lock file's mode, or null when no lock file exists — the state of a directory no mutator has ever run in.

lock.description: Whether the state directory lock was held at examination time. Held by the daemon is the healthy single-mutator state (CLI-007).

free_bytes.description: Free space on the state filesystem at examination time.

free_floor_bytes.description: The configured spool free-space floor the figure above is compared against.

schema_version.description: The state schema version the snapshot reported.

scanned_sources.description: Sources the supplied adapter scans covered.

unreadable_sources.description: Scans whose classification forced the failed coverage state: read, permission, or transport failures.

receipt_count.description: Server-issued receipts in local state — the durable linkage evidence.

freshest_event_at.description: The freshest event timestamp local state records, the clock-sanity reference; null when state holds no timed rows.

evidence.description: The evidence figures behind the check verdicts.

mode-literal.description: A permission mode as a four-digit octal literal.
